$comment: Red-team blocked-entry probes default to 6 per tick, capped at 50; redTeamQueue.maxProbesPerTick operator override takes precedence over redTeam.queue.maxProbesPerTick here. Red-team queue floor: minimum concurrent starts when CPU idle meets the threshold. WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_MIN_CONCURRENT, WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_MIN_CONCURRENT_IDLE_PCT, and WE_RED_TEAM_QUEUE_REVIEW_STARTS_WHILE_IDLE override these values; file/env minimum concurrency and idle review starts are capped at 6; operator override minimum concurrency may reach 12.
